mapper.select: select f.file_path from mind_map mm inner join file_node_relation fn on fn.node_id = mm.node_id inner join file f on f.file_id = fn.file_id where mm.node_name = #{nodeName}

select f.* from file f,file_project_relation fp where fp.project_id=${projectId} and fp.file_id = f.file_id
and (f.file_name like '%${key}%' or f.file_type like '%${key}%')
order by f.file_id limit ${pageSize} offset ((${pageNum} - 1) * ${pageSize})

select count(1) from file f,file_project_relation fp where fp.project_id=${projectId} and fp.file_id = f.file_id
and (f.file_name like '%${key}%' or f.file_type like '%${key}%')
select count(1) from file_project_relation fp,file_tag_relation ft where fp.file_id = ft.file_id and fp.project_id=#{projectId}
